content.text:
Code tasks should now show the live tokens/s, though I haven't watched it in a real Code task. The spec step's guess was wrong: `--include-partial-messages` was already passed on every Claude Code run. The real problem was that the live rate rarely got a chance to appear:

- **Thinking wasn't counted.** Suspense ignored Claude Code's streamed thinking, so the rate only showed during visible reply text, which is a small part of a Code task. Thinking now counts as writing.
- **Short replies were too short.** The rate waited 0.5 seconds before showing, longer than the short replies between tool calls usually last. It now shows after 0.2 seconds.
- **A tool call with no recorded result blocked it.** If one never reported back, the rate stayed hidden for the rest of the run. Text arriving now clears that.

As the spec asks, the rate now also shows beside a running row's time in the Tasks tab, including a running chain step's row, and in the compact header rows. New tests cover the live rate in a running Code task's header, and they pass. The full suite has the usual spec-rename failures, plus `restart_from_within_the_window_never_panics`, which has failed in full runs before and passed when re-run alone.

Code tasks should now show the live tokens/s, though I haven't watched it in a real Code task. The spec step's guess was wrong: `--include-partial-messages` was already passed on every Claude Code run. The real problem was that the live rate rarely got a chance to appear:

- **Thinking wasn't counted.** Suspense ignored Claude Code's streamed thinking, so the rate only showed during visible reply text, which is a small part of a Code task. Thinking now counts as writing.
- **Short replies were too short.** The rate waited 0.5 seconds before showing, longer than the short replies between tool calls usually last. It now shows after 0.2 seconds.
- **A tool call with no recorded result blocked it.** If one never reported back, the rate stayed hidden for the rest of the run. Text arriving now clears that.

As the spec asks, the rate now also shows beside a running row's time in the Tasks tab, including a running chain step's row, and in the compact header rows. New tests cover the live rate in a running Code task's header, and they pass. The full suite has the usual spec-rename failures, plus `restart_from_within_the_window_never_panics`, which has failed in full runs before and passed when re-run alone.
